$comment: Licence notices for packages that publish none in their own artefact. MIT and BSD both require the notice to be REPRODUCED in distributions; a package omitting it from its tarball does not remove that duty, it just means the text has to be fetched from where the project actually keeps it. Each entry names a sibling package, already in the inventory, whose licence file IS the same project's — never a text typed out by hand. A sibling in ANOTHER ecosystem is named with `inheritsFromEcosystem`; one repository publishing both a Go module and an npm package under one licence is ordinary, and refusing to look across the boundary would force exactly the hand-typed prose this file exists to avoid. `make notices` fails if the sibling is absent or if the package it covers has since started shipping its own.

sources.justification: Both are packages of the xterm.js monorepo (xtermjs/xterm.js), published together from one repository under one MIT licence held by 'The xterm.js authors'. addon-search ships that licence file in its tarball and addon-serialize omits it; the licence, the holder and the terms are identical, so reproducing the sibling's file discharges the notice requirement for both. Verified by comparing the shipped LICENSE files of the sibling addons, which are byte-identical to each other.

The package declares MIT and names its own source in its package.json: repository wailsapp/wails, directory v3/internal/runtime/desktop/@wailsio/runtime. It ships no licence file in its tarball. That directory sits inside the v3/ module root of github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3@v3.0.0-beta.16, already in this inventory, whose LICENSE is MIT, 'Copyright (c) 2018-Present Lea Anthony' — the nearest licence file governing the package's own source. Same repository, same version, same licence, same holder; reproducing that file is what discharges the notice requirement for the runtime the frontend links. Verified by reading both files on 2026-09-05. Approved 2026-09-06 after reading both artefacts: the package declares MIT and names its source as wailsapp/wails, directory v3/internal/runtime/desktop/@wailsio/runtime, and ships no licence file (its files list is dist and types); that directory lies inside the module root of github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3@v3.0.0-beta.16, already shipped in this inventory, whose LICENSE is MIT, "Copyright (c) 2018-Present Lea Anthony". Same repository, same commit, same licence, same holder; pre-release status does not bear on it.
